notes.title: Updates
notes.content:
List of updates:
- Correction of Minor Errors
- The settings menu added : Volume,Window mode,Graphics settings.

notes.title: CosmoDrive: Zero has been updated!
notes.content:
*The game has been completely reworked
*Game engine switched to UE4
*The game mechanic has been changed - now it is more dynamic
*New soundtrack
*Random level generation
*Added a few more languages
*Reworked achievements are now unlockable, fixed unobtainable achievements bug

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fix bugs

If you didn't recive the update - verify the game cash.

notes.title: CD: Zero update
notes.content:
—- Levels are changed and expanded
—- Added ship selection
—- Changed the main menu interface 
—- Added 4 languages 
—- Now difficulty changes as you progress through the level

Also we want to announce, that if you support the game with your reviews, we will be able to add trading cards.  Let's do it, guys!
